# `kernel/ThemeEngine.js`

> **Source:** `webgpu-os/kernel/ThemeEngine.js`

ThemeEngine.js — Kernel-level theme orchestration service. Single source of truth for all OS appearance state. Exposes a middleware-chain hook system so mods can intercept theme changes before or after they are applied to the DOM. ── Modder API ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── const tm = syscalls.theme; // Before hook — middleware: receive appear + next(modified) tm.before('my-mod', (appear, next) => next({ ...appear, chromeStyle: 'metal' }), 'Force metal chrome'); // After hook — react to a completed theme change tm.after('my-mod', (appear) => console.log('Theme applied:', appear)); // Remove hooks tm.removeHook('my-mod'); // Reorder tm.moveHook('my-mod', 'before', 1);           // move to index 1 in before list // Preview (no save, no events) tm.preview({ ...tm.current(), chromeStyle: 'metal' }); // Apply (save + emit os:theme-change) tm.apply({ ...tm.current(), themeId: 'crimson' }); // Export / import theme JSON const json = tm.export(); tm.import(json); // List registered hooks tm.hookList(); // → [{ id, phase, description, enabled, order }]

## Notes & Examples

### Command Bus Pattern

The OS uses a capability-gated command bus for inter-app and system communication. Apps register command handlers; the kernel routes commands based on capabilities. Commands can be local (same app), cross-app (with permission), or system-level (elevated).

**Example: Command registration and invocation**
```js
import { CommandBus } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/CommandBus.js';
import { Capability } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/Capability.js';

const bus = new CommandBus();

// Register a handler (requires 'ui' capability)
bus.register('myapp:openFile', async (path) => {
  const content = await storage.read(path);
  return { content, size: content.length };
}, { capability: 'storage' });

// Invoke locally
const result = await bus.invoke('myapp:openFile', '/docs/readme.md');

// Cross-app invocation (requires 'interop' capability)
const otherApp = bus.proxy('otherapp');
const data = await otherApp.invoke('otherapp:compute', input);

// Broadcast to all listening apps
bus.broadcast('system:themeChanged', { theme: 'dark' });
```

**See also:** [WebGPU OS Architecture](/webgpu-os/architecture.md) · [Security Model](/concepts/security-model.md)
